summary_en: NIFCO will cancel 19.6 million shares, representing 9.8% of issued shares post-split, effective October 7, 2026. The cancellation reflects a 2-for-1 stock split scheduled for September 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Cancellation of Treasury Stock (Cancellation of Treasury Stock Based on Article 178 of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: NIFCO announced on September 29, 2026, that its board of directors has resolved to cancel 19,609,228 treasury shares effective October 7, 2026. The shares to be cancelled represent 9.8% of the issued shares following a 2-for-1 stock split scheduled for September 30, 2026 with a record date of the same day. The number of shares disclosed reflects the post-split quantity; on a pre-split basis, the cancellation would involve 9,804,614 shares. Following the cancellation, the total number of issued shares will be 180,856,000 (or 90,428,000 on a pre-split basis). The company disclosed no specific reason for the cancellation timing or strategic rationale in the notice.
